QuestInfo.name: Straight from the Hunter's Mouth
QuestInfo.0: If the #bsnow monster#k is truly a child, as some witnesses claim, what is the right course of action? Even the villagers cannot agree on what must be done. Perhaps the hunters who face danger daily can be of service.
